items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So they got on Rod and said how can you get a hold of Ernie Fields and so Rod told them and so I said Rod, what do you say? He said yeah, if they give us enough money, if I sell that I'm going to sell you too, I think we ought to get fifty thousand.

ctx.x: So they got on Rod and said how can you get a hold of Ernie Fields and so Rod told them and so I said Rod, what do you say? He said yeah, if they give us enough money, if I sell that I'm going to sell you too, I think we ought to get fifty thousand. He said we'll have twenty five a piece; and so I said okay and that's what I said to Capitol.
